[ⲟ]ⲩⲉⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲗⲏ — indefinite article ⲟⲩ-; one letter restored.
Standard relative-perfect 'that they sent forth from' parallels lines 2-3; followed by ⲡⲱϣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ in next line.
Standard formula 'in which all the tidings... are written down' parallels lines 4-5; relative + ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲁ confirmed by ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥⲏϩ in next line.

7 chars; the molding of man 'gave/uttered' the Answer — ⲁϥⲧⲁⲩⲁϥ 'he gave it forth' fits sense (the Answer the rational makes when pressed) and approximate length, though uncertain.
2-char trace with two unclear partial letters; cannot be resolved without more context.

restoration_note: This teaching frames the Apostolic salutation as the cosmic letter exchanged between the Lord's outgoing Call (ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ) and the soul's answering Hearing (ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ), with the Answer (ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃ) returning upward through the molding of man (ⲡⲱϣⲡⲧ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ) to the Living Spirit. Most gaps are tightly constrained by the chiastic parallel between the descending letter (sections 4476-4481) and the ascending letter (sections 4484-4490): each phase pairs Calling with Answer, sending-forth with returning, and inscribes upon the letter all the wars and strifes the archons raised against the rational. Short morphological and lexical gaps (articles, demonstratives, completions of ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ, ⲡⲟⲩⲱϣⲃ, ⲁⲥⲡⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ, ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲁ, ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ, ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ) restore with high confidence. Four medium lacunae (12, 21, 22, 23, 24) where verb-suffix strings or lost letters are not constrained by the parallel formula are left unrestored or marked low; gap 12 receives a tentative ⲭⲓⲧⲥ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ on the basis of the molding's reception of the Calling.
